Once the spring hinge is closed, the honeycomb textured base ensures even heat flow, baking the layers of the cake consistently. Double layer non-stick coating eliminates the need for flouring the pan Made of steel; reinforced non-stick coating for easy release and quick cleanup OVEN SAFE TO 450 DEGREES Fahrenheit.
